svg.text: ProcessData and ProcessLoan — How Month-End Works
1 The two procedures — what each one does
• Full batch calculation across the whole credit line
• Not scoped to a single loan
• At month-end, creates the history tables from the
data as it stands at the moment it runs
• When run for the last month, it also closes that month
• Runs on every loan save and wire save / upload
• Calculates only the one loan being saved
• Previously also updated history tables — but only
during the month-end window (see panels 2 and 3)
On the last day of the month only, each save also topped up the history tables as activity occurred.
Old save path tops up history
3 After July 9, 2026 — with Process Data run on the last day of the month
The month-end history top-up was removed, on the implicit assumption that the close runs the day after month-end.
4 Corrected schedule — Process Data runs the day after month-end
The close runs once, after the month is genuinely complete — so no top-up during the day is needed at all.
with the full month of activity.
